note: Gamer slang translated for someone who doesn't play. Check each meaning with a real player (ideally the gamer in someone's family). `actions` links to ids in games/fortnite.json; leave it empty for words that aren't a button press.

terms.means: Quickly build walls (and a roof) all around yourself to hide from attacks
Build ramps and walls in a fast spinning pattern to climb high above other players
While you're fighting one player, a third player shows up and attacks you both
The shrinking danger zone that hurts you if you stay outside the safe circle
Move to a new spot on the map, usually to stay inside the safe circle
Land somewhere busy at the start of the game where lots of other players also land
Weapons and items you pick up from the floor or from chests
An extra health bar that protects you before your real health goes down
Really, really good at the game (a compliment)
A computer-controlled player, or an insult for a player who isn't very good
Playing very seriously and competitively, trying extremely hard
Rushing straight at the enemy without hiding (from pressing W to go forward on a keyboard)
"Good game". Said at the end of a match, win or lose
Winning the match: you're the last player or team left
